title: Prison Break: Warden Neyremal and High Shaman Yenner
summary: Free the prisoners, stop the alarm and defeat the warden and high shaman together.
overview: Free the prisoners, stop the alarm and defeat the warden and high shaman together.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Assign control for both final bosses and prepare healing for their 20% frenzies.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Defeat the three taskmasters and use their keys to release the first prisoners.
The last release calls Prison Guard Talkor. Engage him promptly before his escape sequence completes.
Clear the prison rooms so the rescuers can free their allies.
Warden Neyremal and High Shaman Yenner share aggro. Each heals and increases melee damage at 20%. Both must die for the final chest check.

notes: Approval E281. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
